reference: By the time the couple got their straws, he had put the umbrella and the cherry on top.
sk: Kým pár dostal slamky, on už bol dal navrch dáždniček a čerešňu.
cz: Než pár dostal brčka, on už byl dal navrch deštníček a třešeň.
acceptable: By the time the couple {got|received} their straws, he had {already |}{put|placed} the {umbrella|cocktail umbrella|paper umbrella} and {the |}cherry on top.
He had {already |}{put|placed} the {umbrella|cocktail umbrella|paper umbrella} and {the |}cherry on top by the time the couple {got|received} their straws.

mistakes.text: By the time the couple got their straws, he {put|placed} the umbrella and the cherry on top.
mistakes.kind: Past Simple instead of Past Perfect
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri „by the time“ bol dej hlavnej vety hotový skôr, preto Past Perfect: „had put“, nie „put“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U „by the time“ byl děj hlavní věty hotový dřív, proto Past Perfect: „had put“, ne „put“.
mistakes.feedback_en: With “by the time”, the main action was finished earlier, so use Past Perfect: “had put”, not “put”.

mistakes.text: By the time the couple got their straws, he has {put|placed} the umbrella and the cherry on top.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Príbeh je v minulosti, preto Past Perfect „had put“, nie Present Perfect „has put“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Příběh je v minulosti, proto Past Perfect „had put“, ne Present Perfect „has put“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The story is in the past, so use Past Perfect “had put”, not Present Perfect “has put”.

mistakes.text: By the time the couple had got their straws, he {put|placed} the umbrella and the cherry on top.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past Perfect patrí k skoršiemu deju v hlavnej vete: „had put“; po „by the time“ zostáva Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past Perfect patří k dřívějšímu ději v hlavní větě: „had put“; po „by the time“ zůstává Past Simple.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Perfect goes with the earlier action in the main clause: “had put”; after “by the time” keep Past Simple.

mistakes.text: By the time the couple got their straws, he was {put|placed} the umbrella and the cherry on top.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Past Perfect sa tvorí „had“ + past participle, nie „was“: „had put“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Past Perfect se tvoří „had“ + třetí tvar, ne „was“: „had put“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Past Perfect is “had” + past participle, not “was”: “had put”.

mistakes.text: Until the couple got their straws, he had {put|placed} the umbrella and the cherry on top.
mistakes.kind: until instead of by the time
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Kým“ tu znamená „by the time“ (do tej chvíle), nie „until“ (až kým).
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Než“ tu znamená „by the time“ (do té chvíle), ne „until“ (dokud).
mistakes.feedback_en: Here the meaning is “by the time” (at or before that moment), not “until”.

source_issues: SK/CZ add 'už' (already) and use the archaic pluperfect 'bol dal / byl dal'; 'already' accepted.
